newsitem.title: USA: Shoney's shareholders committee seek meeting.
newsitem.headline: Shoney's shareholders committee seek meeting.

text.p: The Shoney's Shareholders Committee on Monday said July 14 is the deadline for Shoney's Inc shareholders to submit agent designation cards calling for a special shareholders meeting to consider the removal of the company's directors.

The committee, led by Raymond Schoenbaum, said it must receive agent designation cards representing at least 10 percent of Shoney's outstanding shares, including about eight percent of stock owned by the committee, in order to call a special meeting.
The committee said it has filed materials with the Securities and Exchange Commission regarding its solicitation of the agent designation cards.

On June 30, the committee filed suit in U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Tennessee seeking a preliminary injunction preventing the company from implementing certain bylaw amendments it adopted June 22.
